title: private-installer: automate secrets + KMS/HSM + TLS rotation for private deployments
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: enable customers using Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) to automate secrets lifecycle, integrate cloud KMS or on-prem HSM-backed keys, and rotate TLS certs for long-running clusters. Scope: 1) Terraform modules to provision KMS keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and generate IAM/service-account bindings; 2) Helm chart updates to optionally deploy sealed-secrets controller + vault-secrets-operator and to integrate cert-manager with ACME/CA issuance; 3) Installer hooks for runtime migration/re-encryption of sealed secrets when keys rotate or when moving from sealed-secrets to Vault; 4) Upgrade/rollback hooks and CRD migration scripts; 5) E2E smoke tests and CI matrix for Helm + Terraform combos. Changeset summary: - terraform/modules/kms: new module with aws_kms_key, gcp_kms_key wrappers, key_rotation boolean, and example usage; adds documentation and outputs for key ARNs/ids. - helm/redwood-private/templates/sealed-secrets.yaml: optional flag enableSealedSecrets, adds SecretEncryptionKeyRef to components that store secrets; upgrade hook to re-seal secrets with new key. - helm/redwood-private/templates/vault-agent-injector.yaml: optional integration to use vault-sidecar injector and Kubernetes Auth role bindings. - helm/redwood-private/templates/cert-manager-issuer.yaml: add ClusterIssuer template supporting vault, acme, or self-signed CA; rotation schedule annotation. - installer/upgrade/rotate-secrets.sh: idempotent script used by installer to re-encrypt secrets, with dry-run and rollback modes. - docs/PRIVATE-SECRETS.md: migration steps, recommended key rotation windows, audit prerequisites. Why this approach: sealed-secrets provides a simple K8s-native encryption path for air-gapped clusters; Vault provides centralized dynamic secrets and KMS/HSM provides tamper-resistant key storage for compliance customers. The PR stitches these together and provides automated flows for key rotation without manual secret re-entry. Migration plan (included in docs): 1) Create KMS key with key_rotation enabled using terraform module. 2) Deploy sealed-secrets with controller using the KMS-protected private key or configure Vault transit to use the key. 3) Run installer rotate-secrets.sh --dry-run to validate re-encryption; then run without dry-run to apply. 4) Verify cert-manager issued certs and configure certificateRenewalWindow in values.yaml. CI and testing: added matrix in github/actions/private-installer.yml that runs terraform plan against mocked providers, helm lint, helm template with enableSealedSecrets true/false, and runs the rotate-secrets.sh dry-run in a container. There is an integration job that runs a live smoke test against a lightweight KinD cluster using a Vault dev server and local KMS emulator (only on nightly). Security review: SEC-211 checklist included; HSM integration is pluggable and documented (pkcs11 provider examples + pointers to vendor docs). Backwards compatibility: defaults keep sealed-secrets disabled; enabling features is opt-in and installer will create explicit migration plan prompts. Rollback: upgrade hook creates backup secrets in a backup namespace encrypted with prior key and stores a migration record in a ClusterConfig CRD to facilitate rollback. Notes: this PR intentionally does not ship a production HSM driver (vendor-specific) but provides the PKCS#11 interface and tests to validate the path. Related: SUP-934 customer reported complexity rotating certs in air-gapped clusters; this PR addresses that with cert-manager integration and automated rotation hooks.
commit_summary: Adds terraform kms module, helm templates for sealed-secrets/vault/cert-manager, installer rotate script, docs and CI matrix; migration and rollback hooks included.
review_comments: Luca Romano: Good end-to-end but a few questions: 1) Does rotate-secrets.sh handle partial failures? 2) We should avoid storing plaintext backup in cluster; prefer sealed backup. Please address.

Maya Patel: rotate-secrets.sh now runs in transactional batches, backs up into a backup namespace using the previous key and then re-seals into the new key. Added --dry-run and --rollback flags. No plaintext is stored in cluster logs. Updated script and docs.
Aisha Khan: Can we add a unit test for the terraform module to validate rotation toggle? Also request an integration matrix entry for GCP KMS.
Maya Patel: added terratest-lite terraform plan check and extended CI matrix to include GCP KMS emulation on nightly.
release_notes: Private installer: automated secrets lifecycle and key integration. Adds KMS terraform module, optional sealed-secrets and Vault integration in Helm, cert-manager issuer templates, rotate/re-encrypt tooling, and migration/rollback hooks. Opt-in feature for Private deployments.
